question.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(A∧¬(A∨B))\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
question.worked_solution:
First, we add a column for the part of the expression that's in parentheses, $A∨B:$ 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we add a column for $¬(A∨B):$ 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ | $\,¬(A∨B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Next, we add the column for $A∧¬(A∨B):$ 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ | $\,¬(A∨B)\,$ | $\,A∧¬(A∨B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Finally, we add the column for $¬(A∧¬(A∨B))):$ 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨B\,$ | $\,¬(A∨B)\,$ | $\,A∧¬(A∨B)\,$ | $\,¬(A∧¬(A∨B))\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
